title: Iluvatar CoreX's first AI computing supernode squeezes most GPUs in 1 system
key_facts: Iluvatar CoreX (09903.HK) unveiled the Tiangai 300 IXL144 on 12 Oct 2026 at the 2026 China International Industry Fair.
It integrates 144 GPUs, 18 CPUs and about 10.1 TB of video memory in one rack; the company calls it the industry's highest-density single-rack GPU supernode.
The company says it cuts the cost per million effective tokens by 40% compared with mainstream international offerings.
It follows standard rack specifications and is compatible with various AI ecosystems.
Vice president Zou Xuan: a supernode is a systems engineering endeavour; this is the first of a complete lineup to be presented later.
Iluvatar CoreX says it has served more than 380 customers in over 30 industries, with more than 1,000 projects deployed.
